designDetails.orientation: Strict orthographic gameplay profile facing RIGHT in all 32 poses; crest, both anatomical blades, feet and full tail remain wholly inside each cell without camera rotation.

designDetails.background: True transparent RGBA when available, otherwise perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF; no shadow, scenery, hive resin, text or grid.
